item.title: New Yorkers respond to death of Ayatollah Khamenei with mixed emotions
item.description: As U.S. politicians and protesters roundly condemned the attack on Iran, New Yorkers of Iranian-descent expressed a mix of joy and trepidation on Sunday after Ayatollah Khamenei was killed in U.S. and Israeli military strikes.
